Complete trap domination, sadomasochism and tricks are the main pillars of this circus-themed set. Lure enemies into traps using Hell Boxes from the Butcher dimension, ride a unicycle while running over everyone in your path, and turn your foes into flat pancakes using the new unique Wabbazam Hammer.

"Showstopper" provokes high risk gameplay and gives high rewards in return. Some of the set's abilities are resurrection with subsequent seduction of your killer via a Kinky Balloon, damage increase with health decrease and Wabbazam Hammer that drains your blood instead of weapon durability, letting you control your health reserves for the aforementioned damage bonus.
"Showstopper" also features 15 new augmentations to turn the tides of battle in your favor.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44057409/938c4f49bb439272426f70cfa3106fc81b74e459.gif"]

Fresh off the punishing trials of Descent, Morgan Lee thought he’d seen the worst of the Omega-201 tower. But the tower has a twisted sense of humor. Now, inmates must step into Arena 7, a brand new, unforgiving combat zone where familiar foes from KIBORG: Descent return with a vengeance.

OHKO Mode (One Hit Knockout): Everyone, including you, dies in a single hit. High stakes, high tension.
Collapse Mode: An annihilation cannon strikes the arena from above every 5 seconds. Nowhere is safe!

[p align="start"]We've just deployed a major update that makes KIBORG even better. As always, a huge thank you for your continued support and feedback—it was instrumental in shaping this list of changes.
[p align="start"]🛋️ Local Couch Co-op (via Steam Remote Play Together)

The highly requested feature is here! You can now experience the game's story with a friend on the same screen. While it's local co-op, you can easily invite a friend to play online using Steam Remote Play Together. Grab a couch and get ready for some shared adventures!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44057409/8a6d8cce61b8dc332811c8e8a02a45327fd1d0b6.jpg"]
[p align="start"]✨ Significant UI Polish

We've done a major visual overhaul of the game's user interface. All elements remain in their familiar places (we didn't change the UX), but they now look much more detailed, stylish, and atmospheric. We hope you enjoy the new visual flair!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44057409/afd9107e4a414e19954a2e7de570343e240d7573.jpg"]
[p align="start"]⚡ Major Performance Optimization (CPU)

We performed a deep code refactoring that significantly reduces the game's CPU load. This is especially noticeable in large levels and scenes with many objects. Note: If your performance was previously limited by your graphics card (GPU), you may not see a drastic FPS boost, but overall stability should be improved.
[p align="start"]🎙️ New Narrator Voiceover (Optional)

We've recorded an alternative voiceover for the main narrator in English. This is an option for those who, for whatever reason, would prefer a different delivery. It's important to note: We still consider the original voice to be the canonical one and we love it, but we are listening to our community and want to ensure everyone can find the most comfortable experience. The new voice can be selected in the sound settings.
[p align="start"]📢 New Announcer Lines

The narrator has become a bit more talkative! We've added several new lines that may hint at some story details and immerse you deeper into the game's atmosphere. Don't worry, we've avoided spoilers—just some light and intriguing hints.
[p align="start"]🎬 Intro Video for New Players

To better introduce new players to the game's world, we've added a cinematic intro video that plays when starting a new game. We took it from our launch trailer, so it won't be new content for our veterans, but it will perfectly set the tone for newcomers.
[p align="start"]🐞 Numerous Bug Fixes
As with any major update, we've squashed a bunch of small and not-so-small bugs to make your gameplay even smoother and more enjoyable.
For example fixed chain attack widget stuck on screen
[p align="start"]We hope you enjoy these changes! As always, we'd love to hear your feedback in the comments below.
[p align="start"]Thank you for playing KIBORG!
[p align="start"]Your Sobaka Studio team.

Hello, dear players!
We’ve just released a major patch packed with fixes (details below), and now we’d like to share our current plans and thoughts with you!
MAC build and Consoles will be updated in nearest future!
1. Thank You!

First of all — a huge thank you for your time spent in the game, your feedback, bug reports (especially via F7!), and for the amazing content on YouTube, Twitch, and other platforms! You make our community better!
2. What We’re Working On Right Now
Endless Mode and 6 new arenas — both features are already in development and will be released in just a couple of weeks!
Steam Trading Cards — waiting for final approval from Valve.
Steam Deck — actively working on compatibility improvements to get that sweet verification.
Soundtrack and ArtBook — will be released soon separatly!
3. Co-op — Is It Happening?

We did experiment with local co-op in one of the demo versions, but the game has since become more complex. Just imagine: two players in full "Source" armor means 14 units on the battlefield at once! 😅
Still, we’re exploring the possibility of adding co-op in some limited form. But it’s important to note: online co-op is definitely not happening — it’s technically impossible in "KIBORG".
4. Voice Acting — What’s the Plan?

We know many of you aren’t happy with the current voice acting. In this patch, we’ve added the option to disable character voices individually. We’re also looking into ways to improve this further, but we’re not ready to share details yet.
5. Discord & Leaderboards?
We’re considering adding Discord activities (maybe tournaments or events) and a leaderboard system — but these are still in early discussions.
6. Secret Ideas…
We have some really exciting ideas in the works, but it’s too early to talk about them. Once things are finalized, we’ll share the news — promise it’ll be worth the wait! 🔥
Status effect tick damage can no longer kill the player — it no longer deals damage when the player has 1 health.
Dev Comment: Dying from status effects was one of the most frustrating experiences. With this change, status effects should feel fairer to players.
Status explosions now deal more damage to enemies.
Enemies now have higher levels on difficulties 2 through 7, providing a more engaging challenge.
Adjusted the difficulty curve at the end of Floor 2 and the beginning of Floor 3 to smooth out a difficulty spike.
The "Organic Tissue" augmentation now heals from the last two hits instead of three.
Removed the "Efficient Exchange" perk.

Dev Comment: "Organic Tissue" and "Efficient Exchange" rewarded passive gameplay, such as standing AFK out of combat. This created unengaging playstyles, so we’re addressing this issue in this and the next patch.

We want to address one very rare issue here as well (about 1/100 cases): the shaders cache could break after updates, causing the game to stop running.

notes.title: To fix this, please do the following

items.text: Press Win + R
Copy and paste "%LOCALAPPDATA%\\Kiborg\\Saved" (without quotation marks)
In the folder that opens, delete all files with the extensions .USHADERPRECACHE and .UPIPELINECACHE (do not delete or touch any folders)
Restart the game — the shaders will rebuild and the game should launch correctly
Sorry you had to experience that! 🙏

Hello, dear players!

Thank you for your incredible enthusiasm and positive feedback on Kiborg! We’re rolling out the first hotfix patch—intentionally keeping it focused on fixes rather than big changes to avoid unexpected issues. Many of these adjustments were originally planned for the release but are finally making their way in now.
Moving forward, we’ll keep polishing and improving the game, and yes—we’re also preparing free additional content for those of you who want EVEN MORE! Stay tuned, and thanks for your support!

Corrected soundtracks for video cutscenes
